description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `flatten(items)` koja ugnježdene nizove, na bilo kojoj dubini, pretvara u jedan ravan niz. Redosled elemenata ostaje isti.

Ne koristi `Array.prototype.flat`: cilj je da sam napišeš rekurziju.

Primeri:
- `flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]])` → `[1, 2, 3, 4]`
- `flatten([[], [[]]])` → `[]`
- `flatten([])` → `[]`

Originalni niz se ne menja.
description.en:
Write a function `flatten(items)` that turns nested arrays, at any depth, into one flat array. The order of the elements stays the same.

Do not use `Array.prototype.flat`: the goal is to write the recursion yourself.

Examples:
- `flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]])` → `[1, 2, 3, 4]`
- `flatten([[], [[]]])` → `[]`
- `flatten([])` → `[]`

The original array is not changed.

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function flatten` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(items)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `flatten([1, [2, 3]])`, unutar funkcije je `items` taj niz.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 11.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function flatten` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(items)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `flatten([1, [2, 3]])`, inside the function `items` is that array.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 11 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Prazan niz u koji skupljamo ravne elemente.

- `const result = [];` pravi prazan niz; `[]` je prazan niz.
- `const` jer se promenljiva ne dodeljuje ponovo. Sadržaj niza se menja (dodajemo elemente), što je dozvoljeno.
- Pravimo novi niz, a ulazni ne diramo, pa se original ne menja.
- Svaki poziv funkcije (uključujući rekurzivne pozive) ima svoj `result`.
text.en:
An empty array in which we collect the flat elements.

- `const result = [];` creates an empty array; `[]` is an empty array.
- `const` because the variable is not reassigned. The array's contents change (we add elements), which is allowed.
- We create a new array and do not touch the input, so the original is not changed.
- Every call of the function (including recursive calls) has its own `result`.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz svaki element ulaza, redom.

- `for (const item of items)` uzima jedan po jedan element; u `item` je trenutni element, koji može biti običan element ili ugnježdeni niz.
- Redosled se čuva, pa je i redosled u rezultatu isti.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 9.
text.en:
We go through each element of the input, in order.

- `for (const item of items)` takes the elements one by one; `item` is the current element, which can be an ordinary element or a nested array.
- The order is preserved, so the order in the result is the same.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 9.

text.sr:
Odlučujemo: da li je element niz?

- `Array.isArray(item)` vraća `true` ako je `item` niz. Ne koristi se `typeof`, jer je `typeof` niza `'object'`, kao i za obične objekte.
- Zato se objekti (`{ a: 1 }`) i stringovi (`'ab'`) NE smatraju nizovima i ne poravnavaju se (skriveni test).
- `{` otvara granu „da“; zatvara je `} else {` u liniji 6.
text.en:
We decide: is the element an array?

- `Array.isArray(item)` returns `true` if `item` is an array. `typeof` is not used, because the `typeof` of an array is `'object'`, just like for plain objects.
- That is why objects (`{ a: 1 }`) and strings (`'ab'`) are NOT considered arrays and are not flattened (hidden test).
- `{` opens the “yes” branch; it is closed by `} else {` on line 6.

text.sr:
Ako je niz, poravnavamo ga istom funkcijom i dodajemo rezultat. To je **rekurzija**.

- Rekurzija: funkcija poziva samu sebe za manji deo problema. `flatten(item)` poravnava ugnježdeni niz `item`, koji može sadržati svoje ugnježdene nizove, i tako redom.
- Izlaz iz rekurzije postoji: niz koji nema ugnježdenih nizova prolazi kroz petlju bez ikakvog rekurzivnog poziva i vraća se.
- `result.push(...)` dodaje elemente na kraj niza `result`. `push` prima koliko god argumenata.
- `...flatten(item)` je **spread**: raspakuje vraćeni ravan niz u zasebne argumente, pa je `push(...[2, 3])` isto što i `push(2, 3)`.
- Zašto spread: `result.push(flatten(item))` bi dodao ceo niz kao JEDAN element, pa rezultat ne bi bio ravan.

Tok za `flatten([1, [2, [3]]])`:

```
flatten([1, [2, [3]]])
  item = 1        → nije niz → result = [1]
  item = [2, [3]] → niz → flatten([2, [3]])
      item = 2    → result = [2]
      item = [3]  → niz → flatten([3]) vraća [3] → result = [2, 3]
      vraća [2, 3]
  result = [1, 2, 3]
```
text.en:
If it is an array, we flatten it with the same function and add the result. This is **recursion**.

- Recursion: a function calls itself for a smaller part of the problem. `flatten(item)` flattens the nested array `item`, which may contain its own nested arrays, and so on.
- There is an exit from the recursion: an array that has no nested arrays goes through the loop with no recursive call and is returned.
- `result.push(...)` adds elements to the end of the array `result`. `push` accepts any number of arguments.
- `...flatten(item)` is **spread**: it unpacks the returned flat array into separate arguments, so `push(...[2, 3])` is the same as `push(2, 3)`.
- Why spread: `result.push(flatten(item))` would add the whole array as ONE element, so the result would not be flat.

Flow for `flatten([1, [2, [3]]])`:

```
flatten([1, [2, [3]]])
  item = 1        → not an array → result = [1]
  item = [2, [3]] → an array → flatten([2, [3]])
      item = 2    → result = [2]
      item = [3]  → an array → flatten([3]) returns [3] → result = [2, 3]
      returns [2, 3]
  result = [1, 2, 3]
```

text.sr:
Početak grane „inače“.

- `} else {` zatvara granu „da“ iz linije 4 i otvara granu koja se izvršava kad uslov NIJE tačan, tj. kad `item` nije niz. Zatvara se u liniji 8.
text.en:
The start of the “otherwise” branch.

- `} else {` closes the “yes” branch from line 4 and opens the branch that runs when the condition is NOT true, i.e. when `item` is not an array. It closes on line 8.

text.sr:
Običan element se samo dodaje.

- `result.push(item)` dodaje taj jedan element na kraj niza `result`, tačno na mesto koje mu po redosledu pripada.
text.en:
An ordinary element is simply added.

- `result.push(item)` adds that one element to the end of the array `result`, exactly in the place it belongs to by order.

text.sr:
Zatvara granu „inače“ (otvorenu u liniji 6).

- `}` zatvara `else` blok. Posle njega petlja prelazi na sledeći element.
text.en:
Closes the “otherwise” branch (opened on line 6).

- `}` closes the `else` block. After it the loop moves on to the next element.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 3.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 3.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Vraća ravan niz.

- `return result` šalje sve prikupljene elemente pozivaocu. Za prazan ulaz ili ulaz od samih praznih nizova, `result` je ostao prazan, pa se vraća `[]`.
- U rekurzivnom pozivu, onaj ko poziva je sama funkcija `flatten` iz linije 5, koja taj rezultat raspakuje spread-om.
text.en:
Returns the flat array.

- `return result` sends all the collected elements to the caller. For an empty input or an input of only empty arrays, `result` stayed empty, so `[]` is returned.
- In a recursive call, the caller is the function `flatten` itself from line 5, which unpacks that result with spread.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Svaki nivo ugnježdenja se rešava istom funkcijom; izlaz iz rekurzije je niz bez ugnježdenih nizova.
note.en: Every nesting level is solved by the same function; the exit from the recursion is an array with no nested arrays.
